title: Concatenate
description: Concatenate a list of columns or a list within a single column.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Either a single column name or list of columns.

parameters.name: char
parameters.description: (Optional) Character to add between successive values.

parameters.name: skip_empty
parameters.description: Whether to skip empty values, defaults to false.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
If the input is a list of columns, concatenate multiple columns into one as a delimited string. If the input is a single column, concatenate a list within that column into a delimited string. ## Migrated examples #### Concatenating 3 Columns ##### Recipe ```yaml # Using concatenate to combine multiple columns wrangles: - merge.concatenate: input: - Col1 - Col2 - Col3 output: Join Col char: ', ' ```
##### Input Sample | Col1 | Col2 | Col3 | | --- | --- | --- | | A | B | C |
##### Output Sample | Join Col | | --- | | A, B, C |
#### Concatenating a Single Column ##### Recipe ```yaml # Using concatenate to join a column that is a list wrangles: - merge.concatenate: input: Col1 output: Join List char: ' ' ```
##### Input Sample | Col1 | | --- | | ['A', 'B', 'C'] |
##### Output Sample | Join List | | --- | | A B C |
